note: rustre-forensics-mem is a workspace library crate (Windows/Linux memory analyzers, PE scanner, stack canaries, NT heap, UTF-16 strings, process_tree, kernel_forensics). The MCP server (crates/rustre-mcp-tools/src/lib.rs, register_forensics_group near L6921) exposes only 'forensics.open_memory_dump' and 'forensics.run_plugin', both of which are static placeholder stubs that do NOT invoke rustre-forensics-mem (returns hardcoded pslist/netscan strings; no calls to WindowsAnalyzer/LinuxAnalyzer/MemoryForensicsScanner). No other rustre-mcp* crate depends on rustre-forensics-mem (verified via grep). Direct JSON-RPC stdio comparison vs validator is therefore N/A. The crate is consumed by sibling library crates (rustre-forensics-fs, rustre-forensics-plugins) and surfaced in the GUI (rustre-gui processes panel).
